title: What happens to your brain if you stay awake for 24 hours?
description:
After 24 hours awake, your attention and coordination can be as impaired as if you were over the legal driving limit. Here is the short version.

Source: Dawson & Reid, 1997, Nature ("Fatigue, alcohol and performance impairment").

#shorts #psychology #sleep

scenes.headline: 24 HOURS
scenes.text: What happens to your brain if you stay awake for twenty-four hours?

scenes.label: like a blood alcohol of 0.05
scenes.text: By hour seventeen, your performance on attention and coordination tests drops to what you'd see at a blood alcohol level of point zero five.

scenes.label: like a blood alcohol of 0.10
scenes.text: Keep going to twenty-four hours, and it looks like point one zero.

scenes.headline: ABOVE THE LIMIT
scenes.label: IMPAIRMENT
scenes.text: That's above the legal driving limit in many countries.

scenes.headline: SAME RESULT?
scenes.text: You wouldn't drive after a few drinks. A sleepless night can make you just as impaired.

scenes.headline: SO WHAT HAPPENS?
scenes.text: So what happens if you stay awake for twenty-four hours?

scenes.headline: DRUNK BRAIN
scenes.text: Your brain acts drunk, without a drop of alcohol.
